Design a sprint-wise implementation plan for InkOS Analytics page upgrade. Project: /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS (Next.js 16 + Supabase + Tailwind 4, brand-locked, premium B2B SaaS).

## CONTEXT — Audit Findings

The InkOS team produced a UX audit (PDF) of the /reports page. Verdict: cut 2, move 1, fix 14, add 14. Below is a complete summary.

### Existing infra (REUSE — already in repo)
- `components/shared/KpiCard.tsx` — full-featured KPI card with delta, trend, sparkline, CountUp animation
- `components/ui/date-range-picker.tsx` — production-ready DateRangePicker with 7 presets (Today/Last 7d/Last 30d/This month/Last month/Last 90d/Custom). Uses react-day-picker.
- `components/reports/RechartsAreaChart.tsx` + `RechartsBarChart.tsx` — themed, prop-clean
- `components/shared/PageTabs.tsx` — URL search-param tab pattern
- `components/shared/EmptyState.tsx` — variants for empty/no-results/coming-soon
- `components/shared/DataState.tsx` — loading/error/empty wrapper
- `@tanstack/react-table@8.21.3` installed but not used on reports — wire for sortable artist leaderboard
- `papaparse@5.5.3` installed — wrap into `lib/csv-export.ts` shared util
- `lib/utils.ts` has formatCurrency, but missing formatPercent — add

### Routes (each tab is its own route, NOT search-param)
- /reports (redirects to /reports/revenue)
- /reports/revenue, /reports/artists, /reports/clients, /reports/bookings, /reports/inventory, /reports/ai
- Layout at `app/(app)/reports/layout.tsx` renders `<PageHeader title="Reports">` + `<ReportsTabNav />`
- Each tab: server `page.tsx` → client `*ReportClient.tsx` → fetches `/api/reports/{tab}` via React Query

### Bugs (root-caused)
1. **Page title "Reports" → rename "Analytics"** at `app/(app)/reports/layout.tsx:12` (sidebar already says Analytics)
2. **Artists breadcrumb says "Team"** — audit PDF claim; Explorer found no breadcrumb actively rendering, may be ghost from PageHeader fallback. Verify and set explicit breadcrumb on each tab.
3. **Booking Heatmap empty** — `app/api/reports/bookings/route.ts:66-71` heatmap array is correct shape; sparse `scheduled_at` data + zero-value cells render as blank. Need: fix cell rendering (min opacity for zero, constrain to 10–22h business hours), then verify data.
4. **Services all "19 bookings"** — `app/api/reports/bookings/route.ts:74-83` aggregation bug. `service_id` key collision or null defaulting to single bucket. Investigate; fix grouping.
5. **Low Stock contradiction** — `/api/reports/inventory` queries `inventory_items.current_stock <= min_threshold`; `/api/inventory/stock-alerts` queries separate `stock_alerts` table populated by trigger. One source of truth needed.
6. **COGS = $0** — `inventory_movements` empty because Adjust Stock + booking complete don't log consumption. Either fix root cause (write Movements pipeline) OR ship honest empty state until that's done.
7. **Bookings math 54 unaccounted** — `app/api/reports/bookings/route.ts:41-44` only counts `[completed, no_show, cancelled]`. Missing pending, confirmed, rescheduled. Need Status breakdown bar that reconciles total.

### Cuts
- Revenue-by-Period bar chart (redundant with Revenue-over-time line chart) — replace with line/bar toggle on the same chart
- Identical person-icons on Clients KPI cards — kill them

### Move
- Export CSV (currently only on Revenue tab) → move to layout-level header next to date picker, exports current tab + range

### Fix list (14)
- Page title "Reports" → "Analytics"
- Artists breadcrumb "Team" → "Artists"
- Booking heatmap renders empty (P0)
- Services by Popularity all show "19" (P0)
- Low Stock card vs Stock Alerts conflict (P0)
- COGS = $0 (depends on Movements logging — see strategy q below)
- Revenue 5 KPI cards → 4 (drop standalone Tips, surface inside Revenue card sub-line)
- Trend-arrow icons that don't show actual deltas → real deltas with color
- Tooltip $0 on closed days (label as "Closed")
- Revenue chart Y-axis fixed $0–$2000 → auto-scale
- Bookings 6 KPI cards → 3 with rates inline
- Bookings math reconcile (Status breakdown bar)
- Bookings Over Time stubby bars (default to weekly when range > 30d)
- Heatmap hours 0–24 → 10am–10pm business hours
- Clients 6 KPI cards → 4 with deltas
- No-show pill colored Rust filled when > 10%
- Stock value decimal formatting consistency ($X,XXX.XX)
- Monthly AI Cost single bar — show empty state until 2+ data points
- Sortable columns on Artist Leaderboard (currently locked to revenue desc)

### Add list (14)
- **Date-range picker (P0)** — global, in layout header. Default Last 30d. Presets: Today/Last 7d/Last 30d/This month/Last month/Last 90d/Custom. Pass `?from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD` URL params; every tab and API consumes.
- **Compare to prior period toggle (P0)** — pairs with date range. URL param `?compare=1`. Every KPI shows delta. Charts overlay dashed prior-period line. APIs need updating to compute prior-window data.
- **Export CSV global** (covered in Move)
- Avg session $ per artist column on leaderboard
- Sortable columns (rev, sessions, no-show%, tip%, avg session)
- Click-to-drill-down per artist (route or modal — recommend modal/drawer for v1, dedicated route v2)
- Clients: New-clients-per-month line chart
- Clients: Cohort retention heatmap (% of cohort returning month N+1, N+2, N+3)
- Clients: LTV distribution histogram
- Bookings: Status breakdown bar (reconciles all bookings)
- Bookings: Per-service columns — $ revenue, avg ticket, no-show rate
- Bookings: Walk-in vs booked breakdown
- Inventory: Stock value trend line chart over date range
- Inventory: Top consumed items list (depends on Movements)
- Inventory: 4th KPI card — Stock value (currently missing)

## PROJECT CONSTRAINTS
- Stack A — Next.js 16 + Supabase + Tailwind 4 (`@theme inline` only, no tailwind.config)
- Brand: ONLY 4 colors — Bone #F7F7F5, Onyx #0F0F0F, Stone #787774, Rust #B23A2B. No additions.
- Type: Inter (UI) + Instrument Serif (display only) + JetBrains Mono (code). Tabular-nums on every number.
- Shadow tokens custom — never default Tailwind shadows
- Server `requireFeatureRpc` + UI `<FeatureGate feature="analytics">` (Studio+ tier — confirmed in nav-config)
- No `any` types, strict TS, Zod input validation on every API route
- Mobile-first, fully responsive, accessible

## YOUR TASK
Design a SPRINT-WISE implementation plan. Each sprint is a single shippable unit Yash can review/QA before next sprint starts. Optimize for:
1. P0 ship blockers FIRST (so the page stops looking broken)
2. Foundation (date range + compare toggle) early because every later change depends on it
3. Group related work to minimize context switches
4. End sprint should have a QA gate — concrete tests
5. Each sprint should produce visible, demoable progress

For each sprint provide:
- **Sprint goal** (one sentence)
- **Files modified/created** (absolute paths)
- **Tasks** with one-line description each
- **Acceptance criteria** (how Yash verifies)
- **Estimated agent dispatch** (which agents — Koda, Vex, Dato, Vega/Pixel, Quill, Luna, Sage)
- **Risks/dependencies** on other sprints

Produce 4–6 sprints. Don't over-fragment. Answer also: how to handle COGS=$0 — fix root cause now (write inventory_movements on booking complete + adjust-stock) or ship honest empty state and defer? Recommend with reasoning.

Output: structured markdown, no fluff. Caveman style OK in body but keep section headers normal. Under 1500 words.

3	import { authedRatelimit } from '@/lib/rate-limit'
4	import { logger } from '@/lib/logger'
5	import { z } from 'zod'
6	
7	const querySchema = z.object({
8	  from: z.string().datetime({ offset: true }).optional(),
9	  to: z.string().datetime({ offset: true }).optional(),
10	  group_by: z.enum(['day', 'week', 'month']).default('day'),
11	})
12	
13	export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
14	  const ip = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for') ?? 'anon'
15	  const { success } = await authedRatelimit.limit(ip)
16	  if (!success) return new Response('Too many requests', { status: 429 })
17	
18	  const auth = await getAuthenticatedUser()
19	  if (!auth) return new Response('Unauthorized', { status: 401 })
20	  if (!['owner', 'admin'].includes(auth.role)) return new Response('Forbidden', { status: 403 })
21	
22	  const parsed = querySchema.safeParse(Object.fromEntries(req.nextUrl.searchParams))
23	  if (!parsed.success) return Response.json({ error: parsed.error.flatten() }, { status: 400 })
24	
25	  const { from, to, group_by } = parsed.data
26	  const supabase = await createClient()
27	
28	  try {
29	    let query = supabase
30	      .from('bookings')
31	      .select('id, status, scheduled_at, service_id, source, services(name)')
32	      .eq('studio_id', auth.studioId)
33	      .order('scheduled_at', { ascending: true })
34	
35	    if (from) query = query.gte('scheduled_at', from)
36	    if (to) query = query.lte('scheduled_at', to)
37	
38	    const { data: bookings, error } = await query
39	    if (error) throw error
40	
41	    const total = bookings?.length ?? 0
42	    const completed = (bookings ?? []).filter((b) => b.status === 'completed').length
43	    const noShows = (bookings ?? []).filter((b) => b.status === 'no_show').length
44	    const cancelled = (bookings ?? []).filter((b) => b.status === 'cancelled').length
45	
46	    // Timeline of bookings by period
47	    const grouped = (bookings ?? []).reduce<Record<string, number>>((acc, b) => {
48	      const d = new Date(b.scheduled_at)
49	      let key: string
50	      if (group_by === 'month') key = `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`
51	      else if (group_by === 'week') {
52	        const dow = d.getDay()
53	        const startOfWeek = new Date(d)
54	        startOfWeek.setDate(d.getDate() - dow)
55	        key = startOfWeek.toISOString().slice(0, 10)
56	      } else key = d.toISOString().slice(0, 10)
57	      acc[key] = (acc[key] ?? 0) + 1
58	      return acc
59	    }, {})
60	
61	    const timeline = Object.entries(grouped)
62	      .sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b))
63	      .map(([period, count]) => ({ period, count }))
64	
65	    // Day of week × hour heatmap
66	    const heatmap: number[][] = Array.from({ length: 7 }, () => Array.from<number>({ length: 24 }).fill(0))
67	    for (const b of bookings ?? []) {
68	      const d = new Date(b.scheduled_at)
69	      const row = heatmap[d.getDay()]
70	      if (row) row[d.getHours()] = (row[d.getHours()] ?? 0) + 1
71	    }
72	
73	    // Service popularity
74	    const serviceCounts = (bookings ?? []).reduce<Record<string, { name: string; count: number }>>((acc, b) => {
75	      if (!b.service_id) return acc
76	      const svc = b.services
77	      const name = Array.isArray(svc) ? (svc[0]?.name ?? b.service_id) : ((svc as { name?: string } | null)?.name ?? b.service_id)
78	      if (!acc[b.service_id]) acc[b.service_id] = { name, count: 0 }
79	      acc[b.service_id]!.count++
80	      return acc
81	    }, {})
82	
83	    const serviceRanking = Object.values(serviceCounts).sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count)
84	
85	    return Response.json({
86	      kpis: {
87	        total,
88	        completed,
89	        noShows,
90	        cancelled,
91	        noShowRate: total > 0 ? Math.round((noShows / total) * 100) : 0,
92	        cancellationRate: total > 0 ? Math.round((cancelled / total) * 100) : 0,
93	      },
94	      timeline,
95	      heatmap,
96	      serviceRanking,
97	    })
98	  } catch (err) {
99	    logger.error({ err, studioId: auth.studioId }, 'bookings report failed')
100	    return Response.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 })
101	  }
102	}

I have enough context. Service grouping logic looks correct on inspection — the "all 19 bookings" bug is likely a bad `service_id` (single fallback bucket where most bookings have null/same id) or all rows tied to one service in seed data. Bookings math: only completed/no_show/cancelled counted in KPIs but `total = bookings.length` includes all → 54 unaccounted are pending/confirmed/rescheduled.

Now delivering the sprint plan inline.

---

# InkOS Analytics Page — Sprint-Wise Implementation Plan

## Strategic Overview

Page is currently broken in 4 P0 ways. Foundation (date range + compare) blocks ~70% of fix/add list. Sprint order = unblock foundation, then fix P0 visible breakage, then add high-value features, then polish.

**6 sprints, ~10 working days. Each ends with a green QA gate Yash can demo.**

---

## Sprint 1 — Foundation: Global Date Range + Compare + Rename + CSV Util

**Sprint goal.** Wire global date-range and compare-to-prior URL contract through layout, every API, every client; rename Reports→Analytics; ship shared CSV util. No new features yet — just the skeleton everything else hangs on.

**Files modified/created (absolute).**
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/app/(app)/reports/layout.tsx` — title rename, mount `<AnalyticsToolbar>` (DateRangePicker + Compare toggle + Export CSV)
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/components/reports/AnalyticsToolbar.tsx` — NEW client component, owns URL params (`?from`, `?to`, `?compare`)
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/lib/analytics/range.ts` — NEW: `parseRange()`, `priorRange()`, `defaultLast30()` Zod-typed helpers
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/lib/csv-export.ts` — NEW: papaparse wrapper, `exportRows(filename, rows)`
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/lib/utils.ts` — add `formatPercent(n, digits=1)`
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/app/api/reports/{revenue,artists,clients,bookings,inventory,ai}/route.ts` — Zod schema accepts `from/to/compare`; query both windows when compare=1; return `{ current, prior? }`
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/components/reports/*ReportClient.tsx` (all 6) — read URL params via `useSearchParams`, pass to React Query keys
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/app/(app)/reports/{revenue,artists,...}/page.tsx` — set explicit breadcrumb on PageHeader override (kills "Team" ghost on Artists)

**Tasks.**
- Caveman: build date range util once, inject everywhere
- Toolbar component renders right of PageHeader, sticky on scroll, mobile-collapses to icon row
- Compare toggle disabled until valid range; URL state survives refresh
- CSV export button is tab-aware (reads pathname, calls per-tab serializer registered via `useExportCsv()` hook from each client)
- API contract: every route returns `{ current: {...}, prior?: {...} }` shape; clients read both
- Drop standalone "Export CSV" from Revenue tab body (covered in Move)

**Acceptance criteria.**
- Page header reads "Analytics"; sidebar + header agree
- All 6 tabs respect `?from=2026-03-29&to=2026-04-29` — verify with network tab
- Compare toggle adds `?compare=1`, APIs return `prior` block (KPIs unchanged visually this sprint — wiring only)
- Export CSV button visible on every tab; clicking on Revenue downloads `analytics-revenue-{from}-{to}.csv`
- Artists breadcrumb says "Artists", not "Team"
- No Tailwind shadow defaults; brand 4 colors only; tabular-nums on every range label

**Agent dispatch.** Koda (lead, full sprint), Quill (Zod schemas + types), Vex (URL state pattern review)

**Risks/deps.** Blocks every later sprint. If `requireFeatureRpc` doesn't already accept date params in cache key, fix here. React Query keys must include from/to/compare or stale data leaks across ranges.

---

## Sprint 2 — P0 Bug Fixes: Bookings Heatmap + Services + Math + Low Stock

**Sprint goal.** Stop the page from looking broken. Fix every P0 root-cause bug from audit.

**Files modified/created.**
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/app/api/reports/bookings/route.ts` — fix services aggregation (debug seed: confirm `service_id` not collapsing); add `statusBreakdown` (all 6+ statuses, reconciles total); constrain heatmap to 10–22h business hours server-side
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/components/reports/BookingsReportClient.tsx` — heatmap cell min-opacity 0.06 for zero (Stone tint), rust ramp for non-zero; add StatusBreakdownBar; default `group_by=week` when range > 30d
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/components/reports/charts/BookingsHeatmap.tsx` — NEW or extracted: 7×13 grid (Mon–Sun × 10–22), accessible cell labels
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/components/reports/charts/StatusBreakdownBar.tsx` — NEW: stacked horizontal, all statuses, Rust for negative outcomes
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/app/api/reports/inventory/route.ts` — single source of truth: read from `inventory_items.current_stock <= min_threshold`, deprecate `/api/inventory/stock-alerts` consumption from this view (or proxy through this endpoint)
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/components/reports/InventoryReportClient.tsx` — Low Stock card reads only from `/api/reports/inventory`

**Tasks.**
- Investigate "all 19 bookings" — likely seed has all bookings on one `service_id`, or null `service_id` falling through. Add unit test on aggregation given mixed input
- Heatmap: render zero cells with min Stone tint instead of pure transparent (audit complaint = "looks empty")
- Status breakdown bar that sums to total; legend lists all statuses
- Bookings Over Time: auto-pick group_by based on range length (>30d→week, >180d→month)
- Low Stock: kill the second query path; add a TODO doc comment pointing future work to a unified materialized view

**Acceptance criteria.**
- Heatmap shows visible grid even on empty dataset
- Services list shows distinct counts per service (not all "19")
- Status breakdown numbers sum exactly to bookings total — no 54 unaccounted
- Low Stock count matches across `/reports/inventory` and any other surface
- Y range hours are 10am–10pm only

**Agent dispatch.** Vex (DB + API debug), Koda (chart components), Sage (heatmap a11y + visual QA)

**Risks/deps.** Sprint 1 must be merged. If seed data is the cause of "19 bookings", fix seed too; otherwise fix won't be visible in dev.

---

## Sprint 3 — KPI Cleanup + Real Deltas + Chart Polish

**Sprint goal.** Cut 2, consolidate KPI grids, light up real deltas + compare overlays everywhere using the foundation from Sprint 1.

**Files modified/created.**
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/components/reports/RevenueReportClient.tsx` — 5→4 KPI cards (Tips folded into Revenue card sub-line); remove Revenue-by-Period bar; add line/bar toggle on existing chart; auto-scale Y axis; tooltip "Closed" label when value=0 on a closed day
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/components/reports/BookingsReportClient.tsx` — 6→3 KPI cards (rates inline)
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/components/reports/ClientsReportClient.tsx` — 6→4 KPI cards with deltas; kill person-icons
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/components/reports/charts/RechartsAreaChart.tsx` — accept optional `priorSeries` prop, render dashed Stone line when present
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/components/reports/charts/RechartsBarChart.tsx` — same compare overlay support; `mode: 'line' | 'bar'`
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/components/shared/KpiCard.tsx` — already supports delta; verify color logic (positive=Onyx default, negative metrics like no-show% use Rust when worse)
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/app/api/reports/{revenue,clients,bookings}/route.ts` — emit prior-window deltas per KPI; add no-show rate flag for Rust pill

**Tasks.**
- Every KPI card with `?compare=1` shows real delta + arrow; arrow color follows brand (Onyx good, Rust bad-direction-only)
- No-show pill → Rust filled when >10%, Stone outline otherwise
- Charts overlay dashed prior period when compare=on
- Stock value formatted `$X,XXX.XX` consistently (use `formatCurrency` with 2-decimal opt)
- Monthly AI Cost: when data points < 2, render `<EmptyState variant="coming-soon">` instead of single bar

**Acceptance criteria.**
- Revenue tab has 4 KPI cards, single chart with toggle, auto-scale Y
- Bookings tab has 3 KPI cards (Total, Completion rate, No-show rate)
- Clients tab has 4 KPI cards, no person icons, deltas visible with compare on
- Toggle compare on/off → dashed prior line appears/disappears smoothly on every chart
- Tooltip on $0 day reads "Closed" not "$0"

**Agent dispatch.** Pixel/Vega (visual + chart), Koda (KPI grid restructure), Sage (a11y for delta colors)

**Risks/deps.** Depends on Sprint 1 prior-window API. KpiCard already does CountUp — verify it doesn't fight the compare delta render.

---

## Sprint 4 — Artist Leaderboard + Drill-Down + Sortable Columns

**Sprint goal.** Wire `@tanstack/react-table` for the artist leaderboard with full sort, add drill-down drawer.

**Files modified/created.**
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/components/reports/ArtistsReportClient.tsx` — replace static table
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/components/reports/ArtistLeaderboardTable.tsx` — NEW: TanStack table, columns rev / sessions / no-show% / tip% / avg session $, all sortable, sticky header
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/components/reports/ArtistDrillDownDrawer.tsx` — NEW: side drawer, fetches `/api/reports/artists/[id]` on open, charts for that artist
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/app/api/reports/artists/route.ts` — add avg-session $, tip%, sortable surface (computation only — sort happens client-side on returned set)
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/app/api/reports/artists/[id]/route.ts` — NEW: per-artist time series + breakdown for drawer

**Tasks.**
- TanStack column defs typed, no `any`
- Row click opens drawer; ESC closes; URL param `?artist=<id>` for shareable deep link
- Drawer charts respect global date range + compare
- CSV export from leaderboard respects current sort

**Acceptance criteria.**
- Click any column header sorts; click again reverses; visual indicator shows direction
- Click row opens drawer with artist's revenue trend, top services, no-show timeline
- Drawer survives refresh when `?artist=` is in URL
- Mobile: drawer becomes bottom sheet

**Agent dispatch.** Koda (TanStack), Pixel (drawer interaction + a11y), Quill (typed column defs + per-artist API schema)

**Risks/deps.** Independent of other sprints once foundation is in. Drill-down v2 (dedicated route) deferred — drawer ships v1.

---

## Sprint 5 — Clients Insights + Bookings/Inventory Adds

**Sprint goal.** Ship the analytical depth from the Add list — cohort retention, LTV, per-service breakdown, stock value trend.

## Sprint 6 — Inventory Movements Decision + Final QA Pass

**Sprint goal.** Resolve COGS=$0 honestly, ship Top Consumed Items, run a11y + responsive QA pass, lock the page.

### Recommendation on COGS root cause vs honest empty state

**Ship honest empty state now, defer Movements pipeline to its own sprint.**

Reasoning:
1. **Scope.** Writing `inventory_movements` on booking complete + adjust-stock + supplier receipt is its own multi-file pipeline (booking finalize handler, stock-adjust handler, supplier intake, plus migrations + RLS + tests). It's 2-3 days of work that touches inventory + bookings domains, not the analytics page.
2. **Risk.** Backfilling consumption for historical bookings is impossible without a service-cost lookup; any backfill will be guesses. Shipping a guess into a "premium B2B SaaS" KPI is worse than honest empty state.
3. **Trust.** Empty state with "Start logging consumption to see COGS" + a CTA pointing to a Settings page is the brand-correct move.
4. **Sequencing.** Once Movements pipeline ships separately, COGS card lights up automatically with no analytics page changes.
